caption: The install screen asks for staff data plus view and edit access to products, the Online Store and the Shopify admin.
About 3.5 minutes after install German showed as translated and published; the free plan then reported its 1 language limit.
The theme preview of a translated product page in German, with the Langwill language switcher.
Paid plans in the app: Starter $9.99, Growth $19.99 and Premium $49.99 a month, each with a 3 day trial.
Starter showed as a real $9.99 charge after a 3 day trial with no test note, so we did not approve it.
